_comment: Walls that already have somebody else's tag on them.
EVERY COORDINATE IN HERE IS A PLACEHOLDER. They are picked off the middle of the
blocks the mod already knows about, which puts them roughly in the right neighbourhood
and almost certainly not in front of an actual wall. This is the one thing in the mod
that cannot be got right from a desk: a tag has to be somewhere you can stand facing a
flat surface, on a block that belongs to somebody.
TO FIX ONE: stand where Franklin should stand to paint, facing the wall, and read the
X, Y, Z and heading straight off the HUD into the entry below. The heading is what
turns him to face the wall, so it matters as much as the position.
id       stable key; the run remembers which walls are done by it
zone     GET_NAME_OF_ZONE code, for reference only
gang     whose tag is on it -- decides the marker colour and who turns up
x, y, z  where Franklin stands to paint
heading  which way he faces, which should be square on to the wall
The mission picks its walls at random from this whole list, so more entries means a run
you can do twice without it being the same afternoon. Add as many as you like.
